name: Obby Leader
desc:
👍Thumbs up obby leader if you enjoyed!
Can you follow the Leader's Obby?

One player creates a obby while the others must follow and catch them! Purchase obstacles in the shop to make your course even more tricky to follow. You gain points for winning and for not letting people complete your obby.

Controls:
Hold E/Q to raise/lower the platform as leader

Join shift-lock studios for a free trap ! 🎁🎁🎁
